I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store was Pine Crossing.

She posted about it herself in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem with the store login.

I didn't find any later update saying it was fixed, either in that channel or in the shared files she can see. So I suggested she check with Hollis before marking it resolved on the account sheet.
